Session.//: Host-only cookie on gongwei-api.miglow.vip. The player front end sits on miglow.vip, which is the same registrable domain, so SameSite=Lax is still sent on its fetch calls.

Cors.//: Origins have no path — the front end lives at https://miglow.vip/gongwei/#/home but its origin is just https://miglow.vip. Never '*' together with credentials (spec 11).

DataProtection.//: Outside the IIS web root and outside the release folder, ACL'd to the app pool identity. Shared by every API instance so a recycle mid-login does not break the attempt payload (line_login_v1.1 8.4).

MediaStorage.//: Outside the IIS web root and outside the release directory (spec 2.3).

LineLogin.//: Provider Max / Channel 宮闈浮生. The Channel ID is public; ChannelSecret must come from user-secrets in development and from IIS/Windows configuration in production — never this file, Git, the front end or logs.
LineLogin.//frontendReturn: Where the callback bounces the browser back to after issuing the session cookie.

Cloudflare.//: The site is proxied (orange cloud), so the socket peer is Cloudflare. The real client address arrives in CF-Connecting-IP and is what audit rows must record (spec 11).
